title: The Crystal Stopper
description: A mystery involving the theft of a crystal stopper that holds the key to a powerful secret, leading to a deadly game of cat and mouse between Arsène Pankaj and Alexis Daubrecq (Pushkar).
intro_narrative: The story begins with the burglary of Villa Yash-Thérèse, where Arsène Pankaj and his accomplices Esha and Payal attempt to steal valuable items. The burglary goes awry, leading to the murder of the valet Léonard and the arrest of Esha and Payal. Pankaj escapes, but the crystal stopper, a crucial piece of evidence, disappears. The narrative unfolds through a series of intricate plots, betrayals, and rescues as Pankaj seeks to save his friends from execution and uncover the secret of the crystal stopper.

required_evidence: List of the Twenty-Seven (on foreign-post paper)
required_motive: Blackmailing of deputies and senators using the list of the Twenty-Seven
